name: darp
description: DARP — Accreditation Data Portal, Birla Institute of Technology, Mesra

scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @darp/api" "npm run dev -w @darp/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @darp/api && npm run build -w @darp/web
scripts.start: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run start -w @darp/api" "npm run start -w @darp/web"
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
